credentials.title: IBAN encryption keys
credentials.intro: Member bank details are sealed with the club's public key, and this server holds no private key — it can encrypt an IBAN but never read one back. The key that does the sealing expires after a year, so it is a thing the club owns and has to replace on time. Everything below is measured as this page loaded; nothing runs on a schedule.
credentials.registerHint: Paste the public half of a keypair you generated offline with tools/keypair-generator.html. Keep the private half in the club's archive — it is the only thing that can ever read these IBANs again, and no copy of it reaches this server.
credentials.registered: Key registered. Activate it when you are ready to seal new IBANs under it.
credentials.activateHint: Every IBAN saved from now on is sealed under this key, and its 365-day lifetime starts. Any key that was active moves to retiring — its stored rows still need re-encrypting before it can be retired.
credentials.activated: Key activated. Re-encrypt the rows still held under the previous key to finish the rotation.
credentials.revokeHint: Withdraw this key from use immediately, regardless of how much lifetime is left. Rows sealed under it stay readable only with its private half, so re-encrypt them onto the replacement.
credentials.compromiseHint: Use this when the private key may have leaked. The key is withdrawn at once and the reason is recorded permanently. Register and activate a replacement, then re-encrypt every row — ciphertext already copied together with the leaked key cannot be protected retroactively.
credentials.compromised: Key marked as compromised. Activate a replacement and re-encrypt the affected rows.
credentials.empty: No encryption key is registered yet. Until one is registered and activated, no member's bank details can be stored.

banner.missing: Bank details cannot be stored until a key is registered and activated.

banner.expired: Key {{key}} has expired. No new bank details can be stored and no SEPA file can be exported until you rotate.

rotation.intro_one: {{count}} mandate is still sealed under {{key}}. Supply that key's private half so it can be re-sealed under the active key — 100 rows per step.
rotation.intro_other: {{count}} mandates are still sealed under {{key}}. Supply that key's private half so they can be re-sealed under the active key — 100 rows per step.
rotation.keyHint: The private half of the key being replaced — the only thing that can open these rows. It is used for this one request and never stored on the server. Stopping here loses nothing: the next step picks up where this one ended.
rotation.skipped_one: {{count}} row was already moved by a member edit and was left alone.
rotation.skipped_other: {{count}} rows were already moved by member edits and were left alone.
rotation.remaining_one: {{count}} row still to go. With two-factor enabled, the next step needs a fresh code.
rotation.remaining_other: {{count}} rows still to go. With two-factor enabled, the next step needs a fresh code.
rotation.allMoved: Nothing is sealed under this key any more.
rotation.readyToRetire: Nothing is sealed under {{key}} any more. Retiring it records that the rotation is finished; keep the private half archived anyway, in case an older backup ever has to be read.
rotation.completed: Rotation complete — the old key is retired.

terminals.title: Terminal tokens
terminals.intro: Each terminal authenticates with its own bearer token, which expires after a year like the key above. Rotating one issues a replacement alongside the current token: both work until the new one is entered at the device, so a rotation never takes the bar offline. Warnings are measured as this page loaded.
terminals.rotateHint: Issue a new token for {{name}}. The current token keeps working until the new one is used at the terminal for the first time — at that moment the old one stops. The new token is shown once and never again.
terminals.rotated: New token issued. It replaces the current one the first time the terminal uses it.
terminals.pendingHint: A replacement token has been issued and is waiting to be entered at this terminal.
